name: bertbooker
//private: Required for npm workspaces, and it prevents an accidental `npm publish`. It has nothing to do with the GitHub repo's visibility, which is public.
description: Self-hosted award-travel availability tracker on Cloudflare Workers

scripts.//gather: Runs the sources that declare runtime: "local" (today: PointsYeah only) and POSTs what they find to the API. Everything else runs on the Worker and is reached by pressing Search. See docs/SOURCES.md.
scripts.db:apply:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply bertbooker_db --local --persist-to .wrangler-local --config workers/api/wrangler.toml
scripts.db:apply:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply bertbooker_db --remote --config workers/api/wrangler.toml
scripts.db:seed:local: wrangler d1 execute bertbooker_db --local --persist-to .wrangler-local --config workers/api/wrangler.toml --file seed/programs.sql
scripts.db:seed:remote: wrangler d1 execute bertbooker_db --remote --config workers/api/wrangler.toml --file seed/programs.sql
scripts.db:seed:airports:local: wrangler d1 execute bertbooker_db --local --persist-to .wrangler-local --config workers/api/wrangler.toml --file seed/airports.sql
scripts.db:seed:airports:remote: wrangler d1 execute bertbooker_db --remote --config workers/api/wrangler.toml --file seed/airports.sql
scripts.//dev:api: --test-scheduled exposes GET /__scheduled so the alerts cron can be fired by hand; wrangler dev NEVER runs crons on their real schedule. It only adds a route, so it is safe to leave on.
scripts.//deploy: ONE artifact: the worker serves the API and the SPA. The build MUST come first — wrangler uploads web/dist as static assets, so deploying without it ships whatever bundle was lying around.
scripts.deploy: npm -w web run build && npm -w @bertbooker/api run deploy
scripts.//test:ui: Drives the REAL SPA in headless Chrome. Reuses dev:api/dev:web if they are already up and starts them if not, so it is safe to run while somebody is working. Read docs/UI-TESTING.md before touching it — never --headed/--ui/show-report (they open a window), and never let a spec press Search (that spends seats.aero quota).
scripts.//ui:shot: Ad-hoc: go to a page, optionally click through it, write a PNG. `npm run ui:shot -- --path /library --theme review`. --help lists the flags and every theme id.
scripts.//typecheck: e2e/ is deliberately NOT a workspace (so `npm test` cannot pick it up), which also means --workspaces skips it. Checked explicitly here so it cannot drift.
scripts.//test: Offline and serverless, as it has always been. The browser suite is `test:ui` and stays out of this on purpose: it needs two servers and a real Chrome.
